title: Inverse-image cohomology composition
statement: Let f:Y→X and g:Z→Y be scheme morphisms and F any abelian sheaf on X. For any n≥0 and x∈H^n(X,F), first apply the inverse-image cohomology maps for f and g with their specified constant integer comparisons [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], then apply H.map of invImageComp(g,f) at F [lem-pc-coefficient-unit-composition]. The result is the inverse-image cohomology map for g followed by f with its specified constant comparison, applied to x. No coefficient, structure-sheaf, scalar or cartesian assumptions occur.

proof.text: Prove the elementary adjunct formula constant_adjunct_invImage from constantSheafsheafPullbackIso: rewrite its inverse as the reversed leftAdjointUniq, use homEquiv_naturality_right and homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app, then expand the transported composite hom equivalence. Unit naturality gives the adjunct of constIso(f).inv followed by invImage(f).map(m) as the adjunct of m followed by the inverse-image unit evaluated at the top open. Apply the constant-sheaf hom equivalence on Z to the desired inverse comparison identity. Use that formula twice, homEquiv_naturality_right, and unit_conjugateEquiv_symm for the inverse component of invImageComp. Evaluate the composite-unit identity at the top open using comp_unit_app. Injectivity proves constIso(g).inv followed by invImage(g).map(constIso(f).inv) equals constIso(g followed by f).inv followed by invImageComp(g,f).inv at the constant integer sheaf. Only the definitions in the two cited nodes are used; coefficientUnit_comp is not needed.

Apply exactFunctorCompositionComparison to invImage(f), invImage(g), invImage(g followed by f), the inverse of invImageComp, and the original class x. Expand Sheaf.H.map_apply and Sheaf.H.mapFunctor_apply, move the degree-zero constant comparison through the exact functor using Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀, and combine the two degree-zero classes with mk₀_comp_mk₀_assoc. Substitute the inverse constant-comparison identity from step 1, separate its two degree-zero factors again, and use exactFunctorCompositionComparison backwards. Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, mk₀_comp_mk₀, inv_hom_id_app and comp_mk₀_id cancel the target comparisons. This proves the original equality for all degrees and classes without coefficient assumptions or new holes.

lean.statement:
theorem inverseImageCohomology_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (n : ℕ) (x : F.H n) :
    Sheaf.H.map ((invImageComp g f).hom.app F) n
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm ((invImage f).obj F) n
          (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm F n x)) =
      Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage (g ≫ f)) (constIso (g ≫ f)).symm F n x
